title: MENU STICK AND D-PAD REPEAT
why: J10: large deadzones needed nearly full stick travel to navigate, and holding the D-pad only stepped once.
now: Menus respond at half stick travel. Hold the D-pad to repeat after 0.4 seconds, then every 0.1 seconds.

edits.anchor: if(!md){ if(PAD.focus){ padSetFocus(null); PAD.focus=null; } return false; }
edits.replacement: if(!md){ PAD.mDdir=0; PAD.mDmd=null; PAD.mrepAt=null; if(PAD.focus){ padSetFocus(null); PAD.focus=null; } return false; } // v28.xx (cw-cx-menurepeat): a closed menu releases its repeat timers.
